author: Codex; synthetic examples and expected labels authored before live calls

rules.name: Money I still need to pay
rules.prompt: Show me messages asking me to pay an outstanding bill or debt. Leave out paid receipts, incoming payments, free offers, and hypothetical advice.
rules.paraphrase: Put it here when I currently owe money and the sender wants me to settle it. Exclude money already settled, money coming to me, and examples or advertisements.

rules.name: Needs me today
rules.prompt: Flag messages that explicitly need an action from me today or within the next 24 hours. Ignore advertisements, expired requests, and FYI messages needing no action.
rules.paraphrase: I want tasks I must personally complete before tomorrow at this time. Skip sales promotions, old deadlines, and things that are only informational.

rules.name: Interview arrangements
rules.prompt: Include messages inviting me to a job interview or arranging, rescheduling, or cancelling my job interview. Exclude job ads, newsletters, rejections without an interview change, and interviews unrelated to employment.
rules.paraphrase: Keep correspondence about setting up or changing an employment interview for me, including cancellations. Skip vacancy promotions, general recruiting news, and podcast or research interviews.

rules.name: Customer wants their money back
rules.prompt: Tag messages where a customer currently asks us to return money they paid, including partial refunds and duplicate charges. Exclude completed refunds, policy questions without a request, and cancellation without a refund request.
rules.paraphrase: Find customers who are asking for some or all of their paid money back now. Do not include reimbursements already processed, general policy inquiries, or a request only to stop future service.

rules.name: Suspicious access to my account
rules.prompt: Flag reports of actual suspected unauthorized access or unrecognized sign-ins to my account. Exclude general security advice, tests, access I explicitly recognize, and blocked attempts that did not gain access.
rules.paraphrase: Show me when someone may really have entered my account without permission. Skip simulations, safety tips, confirmed legitimate sessions, and attempts that were stopped before entry.

rules.name: Promotional sales emails
rules.prompt: Include advertisements trying to get me to buy a product or paid service. Exclude receipts, required account notices, personal recommendations, and free community events with nothing for sale.
rules.paraphrase: Put commercial offers and sales pitches here when the sender is promoting something for purchase. Leave out transaction confirmations, essential service messages, private recommendations, and noncommercial invitations.

rules.name: Someone is changing my meeting
rules.prompt: Include messages requesting a new time or date for an already scheduled meeting involving me. Exclude initial invitations, unchanged reminders, cancellations with no replacement, and other people’s meetings.
rules.paraphrase: Show requests to move an existing appointment that I am attending to another time. Skip setting up a first appointment, reminders, outright cancellations, and appointments I am not part of.

rules.name: Confirmed trip bookings
rules.prompt: Keep confirmations of actual flight or hotel reservations booked for me. Exclude advertisements, quotes, cancelled bookings, and bookings made only for somebody else.
rules.paraphrase: I want evidence that my air travel or hotel stay has actually been reserved and is still valid. Skip travel promotions, estimates, cancellations, and other people’s reservations.

rules.name: Work expenses needing approval
rules.prompt: Show expense reimbursement requests only when they are for work, more than $100 USD, and still awaiting my approval. All three conditions must hold.
rules.paraphrase: Put a reimbursement here if it concerns business spending, exceeds one hundred US dollars, and needs my approval now. Otherwise leave it out.

rules.name: Orders between two amounts
rules.prompt: Include order confirmations with a final total in USD of at least $100 and at most $500, including both endpoints. Use the final total after discounts and tax. Exclude quotes and other currencies.
rules.paraphrase: Keep confirmed orders whose final US-dollar charge falls in the inclusive range from one hundred to five hundred. Ignore pre-tax prices, proposed prices, and totals denominated in other currencies.

rules.name: October appointments
rules.prompt: Keep confirmed appointments whose current appointment date is from October 1 through October 31, 2026, inclusive. Use the latest date if rescheduled. Exclude cancelled appointments.
rules.paraphrase: Show active confirmed appointments taking place during October 2026, including its first and last day. A replacement date overrides the old date; cancelled appointments do not count.

rules.name: Requests from my team domain
rules.prompt: Match only if the actual sender email domain is exactly acme.example and the message asks me to approve a document. A display name, quoted address, subdomain, or similar-looking domain does not count.
rules.paraphrase: I want document approval requests sent from an address ending in the exact domain acme.example. Inspect the actual address, not the displayed name or message text. Subdomains and lookalikes are excluded.

rules.name: Outages unless they are drills
rules.prompt: Flag messages reporting a current service outage OR confirmed customer data loss, unless the message explicitly says it is a drill or simulation. Resolved past incidents do not count.
rules.paraphrase: Keep real ongoing service interruptions and real confirmed loss of customer data. Either is enough. Ignore exercises, simulated events, and historical incidents that have been resolved.

rules.name: Exact project code in subject
rules.prompt: Match only when the subject contains the case-sensitive literal code ZX-47 as a standalone code, not embedded within a longer word or code. Body mentions alone do not count.
rules.paraphrase: The subject line must include exactly ZX-47 with those capitals and that hyphen, bounded by whitespace, punctuation, or the line edges. A longer attached token or a code found only in the body is excluded.

rules.name: Parcel delivery trouble
rules.prompt: Show messages reporting a current problem delivering my parcel, such as a delay, loss, failed delivery, or action needed to release it. Exclude normal tracking updates and problems already resolved.
rules.paraphrase: Keep notices that my package is late, missing, could not be delivered, or needs me to do something before delivery can happen. Skip ordinary progress reports and issues that have been fixed.

rules.name: Someone is waiting for my reply
rules.prompt: Find messages where the sender is currently waiting for a response from me about a previously asked question. Exclude first-time questions, automated surveys, and threads where my answer has already been received.
rules.paraphrase: Keep follow-ups asking me to answer an earlier unanswered question. Skip new questions, automatic feedback questionnaires, and confirmations that my response arrived.
